billing.title: Billing
billing.subtitle: Manage your subscription, usage, and plan changes in one place.
billing.active_subscription: What you are subscribed to right now
billing.choose_plan: Choose a plan below to unlock full features
billing.starter_msg: Unlock the full Zyene Reviews experience
billing.starter_price: Plans include a 7-day trial on Stripe checkout. No charge until the trial ends if terms apply.
billing.starter_price_no_trial: Subscribe in Stripe checkout. Billing follows your plan’s cycle (intro trials are for first-time subscribers only).
billing.portal_help: Payment method, invoices, receipts, and cancellation are handled securely in Stripe.
billing.plan_section_subtitle: All plans include Google review sync, AI reply tools (where your plan allows), review requests, and dashboard analytics. Higher tiers add more locations and higher monthly send limits.
billing.subscription_ended: Your subscription is canceled or ended. Choose a plan below to subscribe again, or use the billing portal for past invoices.
billing.no_billing_permission: Only organization owners and admins can change plans or open the billing portal. Ask your admin for access.
billing.billing_not_configured: Billing isn’t set up for this environment (Stripe price ID missing). Contact support.
billing.proration_notice: You'll be charged {{amount_due_today}} today for the rest of your billing period, then {{recurring}} going forward.
billing.proration_notice_fallback: You'll be charged a prorated amount today for the remainder of your billing period, then {{recurring}} going forward.
billing.trial_ends_on_upgrade_notice: Upgrading will end your free trial and start billing immediately.
